named_items.title: Contract registration & approval lifecycle (incl. partner-screen contract-add, PENDING -> endorsement -> approval)
evidence: Recorded open: phpapp/PENDING.md:49-52 (R4 residual). Recorded closed later: docs/99-gaps-and-risks.md:84-88 ('Lifecycle door closed (Revamp P5b)'). The two documents disagree; PENDING.md is stale.

Partner-screen door in v51.1: phpapp/index.php:1616-1627 requires licence_module_live('quotes') and can('crm.contract.register')||is_master(); after the INSERT, index.php:1751-1762 sets open_status='PENDING', is_active=0, records branch/requester and calls contract_after_register(). Same lifecycle as the CRM path.

CRM door: phpapp/lib/crm.php:3223-3233 (quote-contract) requires crm.contract.register and an ACCEPTED, current revision (SA-09/10); new contract INSERTed directly as 'PENDING' (crm.php:3308) then contract_after_register(). Group contracts crm.php:1025 and deal contracts lib/opportunities.php:895 also INSERT 'PENDING'.

Lifecycle: lib/contracts.php:1200-1262 ops_contract_open - endorse requires can_endorse_contract_open() and status PENDING; approve requires can_approve_contract_open(), the first signature when two are configured, and a different person unless contract_same_person=yes (contracts.php:1239-1252); reject/reopen (reopen only from CLOSED/REJECTED, 1265-1283); amendments to an OPEN contract take the same signatures (1287+, D-25).

Configurable rule: lib/contracts.php:749-765 contract_open_rule() - setting contract_open_signatures 0/1/2 (default 2); with 0, contract_after_register() (contracts.php:899-905) opens the contract at registration. This is the owner's documented rule (docs/02-permission-matrix.md:286), not a defect, but it means 'two signatures everywhere' is a configuration, not a guarantee.

Observation 1: index.php:1734-1756 inserts with the column default open_status='OPEN' (lib/contracts.php:47) and then flips to PENDING inside try{...}catch(Throwable){} - if that UPDATE fails the contract stays OPEN and live. The CRM paths avoid this by inserting 'PENDING' directly.

Observation 2: the /contract-openings queue (lib/contracts.php:1172-1183) lists every PENDING contract with no branch filter, and ops_contract_open endorse/approve (1217-1252) checks role/signature holders but never scope_allows() against partner_contracts.branch_id; contract_sig_people() (805-817) only ranks names by branch. A Branch Manager of one branch may therefore be able to approve another branch's contract (cf. SA-06, fixed for quotations only).

Observation 3: quote-contract re-uses an existing contract with the same number for the same client and keeps its open_status (crm.php:3303-3305) - intended draw-down, but a CLOSED/REJECTED one is linked as-is.

Tests: phpapp/tests/test_contract_backdoor_guard.php:41-45 is a source-text (strpos/regex) check, not a behavioural test; behavioural coverage in test_contract_open_rule.php, test_contract_openings.php, test_sales_contract_amendment.php, test_opp_direct_win_contract.php, test_quote_group_contracts.php.

named_items.title: Possible duplicate cost recording: job-closure expenses vs inspector vouchers
evidence: Recorded: phpapp/PENDING.md:53-55 (R9 'left as-is'); docs/99-gaps-and-risks.md:152-160 ('Convergence ... still open'); docs/audit-2026-10/07-DASHBOARD-AND-KPI-AUDIT.md:220-224.

Write path A (coordinator, job closure): phpapp/lib/ops.php:8735-8747 (INSERT at 8742) INSERT INTO expenses (travel, local, food, lodging, misc, extra) - now once per job (field finding #21 guard at 8740).
Write path B (inspector voucher): voucher_entries rows (row_total) written in ops_vouchers (phpapp/lib/ops.php ~7775-8125, voucher-save/voucher-entry).

Readers that add both sides: job_profit() phpapp/lib/ops.php:2502-2506 ($expenses = job_expenses_total + $voucher = job_voucher_total) and 2526 ($direct = ... + $expenses + $voucher ... - $dedupe); job_voucher_total() ops.php:2598-2600 sums row_total with NO voucher-status filter (DRAFT/rejected lines count); boss_profit() ops.php:9154-9201 (unified path via job_profit; legacy path 9194 + 9197 sums expenses + all voucher row_total by boss_id with no de-dup); call register cost column ops.php:5511-5512 and call_cost_incurred() ops.php:6222-6229 add both with no de-dup; SBU P&L lib/costing.php:753-762 folds voucher into expenses in unified mode. The month-end cost run (lib/costing.php:325-345 costing_inspector_days) uses voucher days for labour allocation, not reimbursables.

Guard: lib/costing.php:990-1031 cost_sources()/cost_dualwrite_* detector (flags a job when BOTH totals > 0; overlap = min(); category-blind; only closed jobs; scan limited to last N jobs); warning on job detail views/ops/job_detail.php:1050; amber tile lib/areas.php:266-267; worklist /reimbursable-dedup costing.php:1077-1100; opt-in netting setting reimbursable_dedupe (costing.php:1046-1069) default 'off' = count both.
So by default both doors are still summed in profit, cost-incurred and contract margin; the system warns but does not prevent or net.
named_items.what_to_test: On the test copy: close a job entering travel 1,000 at closure; have the inspector add the same trip (1,000) on the monthly voucher (leave voucher in DRAFT). Expect: job Money tab shows the double-entry warning; job_profit cost includes 2,000; /reimbursable-dedup lists the job with overlap 1,000; call register 'Cost incurred' shows 2,000. Switch reimbursable_dedupe to 'net' and confirm profit cost drops by 1,000 while the call-register cost column does not.

named_items.title: Role-specific access to Masters and Admin

sub_classes.GAP-005 BD refused /users while BM opens: Not reproduced (matches permission matrix row 14) - but Users tile still offered to BD

evidence: Recorded: phpapp/PENDING.md:60-68 (R11/R1); docs/99-gaps-and-risks.md:183-199; docs/audit-2026-10/08-GAP-REGISTER.md:529-541 (GAP-005).

Admin rail entry: views/layout_top.php:187-188 shows Admin when ops_area_has('admin') (lib/areas.php:490 = licence ok and >=1 visible tile). Admin tiles lib/areas.php:305-345: Masters tile can('mod.masters.view'); Users/Organisation can('mod.users.view'); Roles & permissions and Role workspaces is_master(); System settings needs mod.settings.view AND settings.manage; Backup/AI settings is_master()||settings.manage.

module_defaults (lib/access.php:859-910): COORDINATOR, OPERATION_MANAGER, SBU_HEAD view 'masters'; BUSINESS_DIRECTOR views ALL modules (incl. users, masters); BRANCH_MANAGER and BRANCH_APP_MANAGER edit 'masters'. Hence COORDINATOR (and BD) see the Admin area - R11 residual confirmed in code.

Generic masters /m/<entity>[/new|edit|delete]: lib/ops.php:3588-3589 maps every m/* route to module 'masters' (needs only mod.masters.view; perm_route_verb() ops.php:3348-3360 returns 'view' for it), then ops.php:3775-3781 master_access_ok($cfg['access']) (ops.php:3263-3268) by TIER: is_admin_level() (MGMT_ROLES lib/access.php:33 = MA, AD, BD, SBU, BM, BAM, OM) or is_coordinator_level(). ops_master_handle (ops.php:4986-4991) deletes/edits with no mod.masters.edit check. So view-only holders BD/SBU/OM can create, edit and delete admin-level masters (offices, expense heads, travel modes, holidays, agencies) and COORDINATOR can edit/delete coordinator-level masters (sub-contractors, sub-con rates, contract numbers, attendance) - consistent with matrix row 12 'Lookups' being tier-based, but the module 'Edit' tick and the permission 'master.manage' ('Manage master data', lib/access.php:199) are not what governs it; master.manage is only checked for work norms, equipment, geofence and report types (workforce.php:429, equipment.php:313, geofence.php:251, idems.php:5043/5153/9596).
/masters index: ops.php:4627-4629 needs is_coordinator_level() on top of the module gate.

/users: ops.php:10338-10339 requires users.manage.branch or users.manage.global (BD holds neither, BM holds users.manage.branch per access.php:1264-1268) - matches matrix row 14 (docs/02-permission-matrix.md:225-226), so GAP-005 is intended; but the Admin 'Users' tile is gated on mod.users.view, which BD holds, so BD is offered a door that refuses (same class as GAP-011).

Sign in as BUSINESS_DIRECTOR: open /m/offices/new and try to add an office; open Admin -> Users (expect refusal/redirect). Repeat as OPERATION_MANAGER for /m/holidays.

named_items.title: Custom permission sets - do they stay effective after configuration changes (role edits, module licence changes, cache)?

sub_classes.Module licence changes: Not reproduced (licence applied live in can())

evidence: Recorded: phpapp/PENDING.md:69-70 (R3) and docs/99-gaps-and-risks.md:50-71 (MITIGATED) and :140-141 (R8 BAM residual).

Resolution: lib/access.php:1111-1127 user_effective_perms() - a non-empty users.permissions REPLACES the role set (role_perms() is used only when it is empty). So a later Roles & access edit (ops_access, ops.php ~3720) does not reach a person with their own set, except (a) modules added after the set was saved - merge_new_module_defaults() access.php:1048-1060 using the '@mods=' stamp (1031-1046) or modules_at_last_save(); (b) the four named owner grants pushed into stored sets by access_apply_owner_grants() access.php:1319-1355. user_perms_to_store() (access.php:1155-1175) stores '' when ticks equal the role, so untouched people keep following the role; user_has_own_access() (1180+) flags departures on the user register.

Licence: can() access.php:1445-1447 calls licence_blocks() BEFORE the per-user set and the master bypass, so switching a module off removes it from every custom set immediately, and switching it back restores the stored ticks. licence_blocks() (lib/licence.php:337+) only covers mod.* rights - fine-grained rights such as crm.contract.register or finance.reconcile in a custom set are not licence-blocked by can(); handlers must check licence themselves (e.g. index.php:1623 does).

Cache: ua() access.php:1357-1359 and current_user() lib/helpers.php:176-191 are per-request statics; licence_disabled() lib/licence.php:146-151 per-request with epoch. No session-stored permission snapshot was found, so a change takes effect on the next request.
Custom roles resolve to their base via role_effective_key() (access.php:1113).
named_items.what_to_test: On the test copy: give a coordinator their own set (untick one item) -> confirm 'own access' badge; then in Roles & access remove a permission from COORDINATOR and confirm the custom-set user still has it (expected by design) while a role-following coordinator loses it; switch Money off under Modules and confirm the custom-set user loses Invoicing on the next page load, and regains it when switched back.

named_items.title: Differences between source and deployed files - mechanism and drift detection
evidence: Recorded: phpapp/UAT-TRACKER.md:23-28 (live ran older files); phpapp/DEPLOY-CHECKLIST.md:7-11; docs/audit-2026-10/10-ROADMAP.md:52 (0.1) and :188 (S-0); docs/audit-2026-10/14-LIVE-CHECKS-GUIDE.md:12-60.

Mechanism: phpapp/deploy-check.php (generated, 1,063 lines) carries $RELEASE = '12b7e03 · 2026-11-15 06:04 UTC · 719 files' and an $EXPECT map of size + first 16 hex of SHA-256 for every PHP file (line 27-28 onward); compare loop deploy-check.php:891-899 reports ok / stale / missing; admin-only, 404 otherwise; config-health section 822-889 (which config file supplies DB credentials, sample file with real creds, admin password mismatch). Generator phpapp/tools/make_deploy_check.php:27-49 (skips config.php, config.local.php, tenants.php, deploy-check.php, tests/).

Local verification (read-only hash comparison done in this audit): all 719 manifest entries match the working tree at HEAD 1a8f3c6; git diff 12b7e03..HEAD -- phpapp touches only deploy-check.php and tests/test_sales_costing_rules.php, so the manifest is valid for v51.1 even though its label says 12b7e03 (the 'v51.1 (in progress)' commit), not c4530f7.

Gaps: (a) only *.php files are fingerprinted - assets/js, assets/css, sw.js, manifest.json/.htaccess, images are not, so stale front-end files go undetected; (b) files present on the server but not in the release (e.g. an uploaded tests/ folder, deleted modules left behind) are not reported; (c) config.php is skipped; (d) APP_VERSION is a constant '2026.10.1' (lib/preflight.php:25-26) that has not changed since October, so the footer/Server check cannot show drift (14-LIVE-CHECKS-GUIDE.md:12-18); (e) regeneration is manual ('php tools/make_deploy_check.php') - forgetting it makes a correct upload look stale or a wrong one look right; (f) index.php:413-715 has a code fingerprint that triggers migrate_all() but it is not exposed as a drift report.

Packaging conflict with the owner's standing instruction (CLAUDE.md, 24 Oct 2026): tools/release.sh copies every git-tracked file (lines ~44-48) - including phpapp/tests/ - and DEPLOY-CHECKLIST.md:44-52 and 14-LIVE-CHECKS-GUIDE.md:24-30 tell the owner to use GitHub 'Download ZIP', which also contains tests/. docs/go-live-guide.md:129-150 says the update zip must exclude tests/, but no script in tools/ builds such a zip. (tenants.php and config.local.php are gitignored, so they are naturally excluded.)
named_items.what_to_test: On the test copy (and later live), signed in as admin, open /deploy-check.php: expect '719 files ... all match' and the release label; deliberately leave one lib/*.php old to see it flagged; check whether a tests/ folder or stale assets exist in the app folder via File Manager (not detectable by the page). Compare assets/js/app.js size/date on server vs repo by hand.
